svg.title: The optimizer moves while frozen-anchor strength stays flat
svg.desc: Token entropy remains active across seven mainline GRPO runs. Several checkpoints gain own terminal score relative to SFT against a scripted heuristic, including a health-failed long run, while the two mainline runs with direct frozen-SFT anchor measurements show no positive trend. A later weak-KL ablation is also flat.
svg.text: The optimizer moves; measured transfer does not
seven reconstructed mainline runs · canonical Modal sidecars
token entropy vs normalized optimizer progress · not a strength metric
RL checkpoint − SFT own terminal-score points/game · paired 95% CI
long DAPO gains +6.25 → +13.22 → +16.48, then fails KL health
Direct frozen-SFT anchors do not climb
frozen-SFT win rate vs optimizer step · point size follows games/checkpoint
Five other mainline runs did not record this anchor; absence is not zero.
